name: Tool & MCP Server Registry
description: Maintains a registry of all tools and MCP servers available to agents, including their capabilities, trust levels, and approval status. Every tool endpoint must be cataloged before agent use, enabling supply chain visibility and provenance tracking.
threat_addressed: Agents invoking unregistered or unapproved tools expose the organization to semantic supply chain attacks (tool description tampering), unauthorized data access, and unmonitored external service dependencies. Without a description content hash at approval time, post-approval modification of tool behavior is undetectable.
enforcement_mechanism: Registry of all MCP servers, tools, APIs, and external services with provenance, version pin, audit date, approval status, and a cryptographic hash of each tool's description content at time of approval. No agent can invoke an unregistered tool (runtime enforced).

security_outcome.pass: Registry complete. No agent invokes an unregistered tool (runtime enforced). All entries have current approval status and description content hash.
security_outcome.fail: Tool not registered or registry record incomplete.

display_detail: Validates that tools and MCP servers are registered with documented capabilities and approval status.
remediation_hint_template: Tool not found in registry. Register the tool using: ancilis approve-tool {tool_name}
